===== 任务287587 11-22 09:11:10 =====
--- 命令 ---
echo "===== e4/e5来源取证 $(date '+%T') ====="
/root/bot/venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import base64, glob
files = glob.glob('/root/*.log') + glob.glob('/root/bot/*.log') + glob.glob('/root/bot/log/*.log')
for f in files:
    try:
        lines = open(f, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read().splitlines()
    except Exception:
        continue
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if ('核对' in l or 'ask=' in l) and ('e4' in l or 'e5' in l or 'Nf3' in l or '国际象棋' in l):
            b = base64.b64encode(l.encode('utf-8')).decode()
            print('HIT|' + f + '|L' + str(i+1) + '|' + b)
print('====SCAN_DONE====')
PY
echo "=====完====="
